Team — quick debrief on Emiya (onsite yesterday):

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (runtime/serve). Excellent system design, kernel-level optimizations experience, strong debugging in Prod.
- Interview consensus: strong hire. Hits IC3 bar; borderline IC4 on systems leadership but prefers IC3 contributor path.
- Candidate constraints: 3-week notice, prefers mid-September start.

Proposing compensation ask and recommended offer:
- Base: $220,000
- Target total comp: base + 0.6% equity (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Bonus: standard Redwood org bonus (10% target)

Requesting approvals on range/level so recruiting can prepare the docs. Attaching a one-pager summary and comp grid for context.

Attachments: Offer_Summary_Emiya_Cho.pdf (pdf), Comp_Grid_Q3_2026.png (image)

Next steps: if I get a thumbs-up from Lauren and HR, Marissa will draft the offer packet and I will schedule the official call with Emiya.

Thanks,

+1 on hire — thanks for the write-up, David. A few thoughts from comp perspective: 

- Range check: IC3 band for Inference (EMEA/US) runs roughly $200k–$230k base with 0.4–0.7% equity typical. Your $220k / 0.6% sits comfortably in market.
- If we need faster close, we can flex to $225k base but try to keep equity within 0.6% to preserve band for future hires.
- Please confirm whether this is an IC3 baseline or if you want to request an IC4 leveling exception (that adds ~0.3–0.5% equity and requires VP approval).

Assuming IC3, I approve issuing the offer at $225,000 base / 0.6% equity (final sign-off pending HR drafting the formal packet). If you prefer to pursue IC4, loop me and I will escalate to Priya (comp committee).

Lauren
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
